name: rhongomiant-no-power-bonus-without-mordred-champion
notes: Rhongomiant (clS3E0HrZL): both clauses are "[Mordred Bonus]". With a non-Mordred champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer, whose UMBRA lineage also enables the Exalted element) the weapon (materialized for real, memory cost 2) keeps its printed power 2 even though player 2 holds 8 cards (influence 8).

rulesClauses: The +4 POWER is a [Mordred Bonus]: it needs a Mordred champion.
